name: Toyooka (Nagano, Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Toyooka village emblem in white: a stylised bird-like swirl with a curved wing.
history: Municipal flag of Toyooka, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 22 November 1950.

features.role: Toyooka village emblem — a stylised bird-like swirl with a curved wing
